title: basicly validation-transcript handoff artifact
description: What VALIDATE hands SHIP, and REPAIR when the verdict is not-met (factory loop requirements 8). One artifact per validated unit, recorded on that unit. It carries the commands as typed, the output as printed, and a verdict against the original requirement rather than against the change summary - because the summary is the builder's account of the work, and a transcript that could have been produced without the change validated nothing.

schema_version.description: Artifact-format version; bump only when a consumer's contract changes.

issue.description: The unit that was exercised, so this transcript can be joined to the verification evidence that admitted it to VALIDATE.

requirement.description: The original requirement this was checked against, named so it can be re-read. The whole state exists to answer a question about the requirement, so a transcript that does not say which one is unfalsifiable.

environment.description: The operational environment the commands were run in. Required because a consumer has no worktree, no fixtures and no knowledge of the implementation, and a transcript from inside the lane's worktree silently answers an easier question.

steps.description: What was run, in the order it was run. At least one: validation is the act of running the thing, so a transcript with no step is an opinion.

command.description: The command exactly as a consumer would type it - one line, not an argv list, because what is under test here includes whether the surface is typeable at all.

output.description: What it printed, pasted rather than described. Empty is a real result for a command that prints nothing, and it is a different claim from a command that printed something the writer chose to summarise.

verdict.description: Whether the original requirement is met. Two values only: REPAIR's entry predicate is validate failed, so an artifact that hedges cannot route the unit. Executing without error is not met - that distinction is the failure mode this state exists to catch.
